settings.leaveTypesHelp: Days per year is the default for every staff member. Leave it empty to not track a yearly limit. You can set different days per person below.

settings.staffTitle: Staff rest days and leave days
settings.networkIntro: Optional. Use it if staff should only clock in or out while they are at the store. It checks the store internet line, so mobile data or home Wi-Fi will not work.
settings.stepRegisterHelp: Do this on a phone, tablet or computer that is connected to the store Wi-Fi right now (not mobile data).
settings.stepTryHelp: Open the Time Clock on the store tablet (or My Attendance on a staff phone). On the store Wi-Fi it shows «On the store Wi-Fi». On mobile data it shows «Not on the store Wi-Fi» and a manager must type their PIN to allow it.
settings.overrideRegistersHelp: Handy if the store internet changes: after one manager PIN, staff on the new line can clock in normally.
settings.sourceLegend: Added by — Manager: the register button · Manager PIN: remembered when a manager confirmed with PIN · Kiosk: follows the registered kiosk.

today.overdueHelp: These records are still open after many hours. Set the real clock-out time — the system never closes them by itself.

guide.title: How attendance works
guide.step1Help: Attendance only covers staff added to this store. Add each person in
guide.step1Pin: with a 4-digit PIN — the PIN is what they type on the Time Clock.
guide.noStaffYet: No staff in this store yet — nobody can clock in until you add them.
guide.noPinCount: {{count}} without a PIN (cannot use Time Clock)
guide.step2Title: Choose where staff can clock in (optional)
guide.step2Help: In the Settings tab you can allow clocking only on the store Wi-Fi, and choose phone and/or store tablet.
guide.networkOff: Store network check: off — staff can clock in from anywhere
guide.step4Help: Today shows who is working now. Records has hours per day and month. Staff request leave in My Attendance and you approve it in the Leave tab.
guide.step3TabletA: a manager logs in on the tablet once, opens
guide.step3TabletB: in the left menu (under POS Terminal — it opens in a new full-screen window) and leaves it open. Staff only type their 4-digit PIN there — they do not log in.
guide.step3PhoneA: staff log in with their own account and open
